quote.text: Then there will be a truce between you and Bani Al-Asfar who will betray you and attack you under eighty flags. Under each flag will be twelve thousand soldiers.

shots.framing: HOOK. Wide: a long hill crest under a pale sky; tall plain banners rise over it one after another until the ridge is full; in the foreground a shepherd boy (10) with his goats freezes and stares
shots.vo_markup: Eighty banners. Under each one, twelve thousand *soldiers.*
shots.vo: Eighty banners. Under each one, twelve thousand soldiers.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Banners rising over the ridge, the frozen boy
shots.notes: Alive from frame 0 (the first banners already rising, goats moving). Ridge fills on "soldiers". Banners have NO real symbols, crosses, crescents, or national colours: plain cloth in dark tones.

shots.framing: Extreme wide: from above the ridge, the army pours down the far slope into a valley like a dark flood, banners swaying above it
shots.vo_markup: Nearly a million men, marching under one broken *promise.*
shots.vo: Nearly a million men, marching under one broken promise.
shots.speaker: narr

shots.framing: Medium: a long table in a bright hall; two delegations (simple faces, plain suits, no insignia) stand; two leaders lean across and shake hands; cameras flash
shots.speaker: narr

shots.framing: Wide: a city square full of people celebrating; a man lifts his daughter, an old couple embrace, paper confetti; NO flags
shots.vo_markup: A truce between the believers and the Romans, exactly as the Prophet had *foretold.*
shots.vo: A truce between the believers and the Romans, exactly as the Prophet had foretold.
shots.speaker: narr

shots.framing: Medium-wide: a sunny port market; cranes and ships behind; kids chase each other between fruit stalls; a merchant laughs with a foreign buyer
shots.vo_markup: For years, it held. Ports opened. Markets filled. Children grew up without ever hearing a *siren.*
shots.vo: For years, it held. Ports opened. Markets filled. Children grew up without ever hearing a siren.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.notes: A child's kite rises on "siren" (ironic calm).

shots.framing: Extreme wide: two allied columns marching side by side across a plain toward a dust storm on the horizon; then the dust clears and the columns raise their arms; silhouettes, no gore
shots.vo_markup: Together, they even marched against a common enemy... and *won.*
shots.vo: Together, they even marched against a common enemy... and won.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Two columns as one, the cheer

shots.framing: Medium: an army camp at dusk; two soldiers from the two sides (plain uniforms of different grey/olive tones, no symbols) stand chest to chest shouting; others rush in to pull them apart
shots.vo_markup: But on the day of victory, a quarrel broke out over whose victory it *was.*
shots.vo: But on the day of victory, a quarrel broke out over whose victory it was.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.notes: No weapons drawn, no blows. The shove on "was".

shots.framing: Close: a hand drops the signed treaty into a fireplace; the paper curls and blackens; the signature burns last
shots.vo_markup: Within a week, the treaty was *ash.*
shots.vo: Within a week, the treaty was ash.
shots.speaker: narr

shots.framing: Wide: the sunny port market from shot 5, now at night: stalls shuttered, a merchant pulls down a metal shutter; behind him huge dark warship silhouettes (no flags, no markings) slide into the harbour
shots.vo_markup: The same ports that had sold them fruit now filled with their *warships.*
shots.vo: The same ports that had sold them fruit now filled with their warships.
shots.speaker: narr

shots.framing: Extreme wide: dusk; a dark coastline crowded with ships and endless camps, banners along the shore, campfires beginning to glow
shots.vo_markup: The Prophet had said there would be a truce with the Romans. They would betray it, and come under eighty banners, under each banner twelve *thousand.*
shots.vo: The Prophet had said there would be a truce with the Romans. They would betray it, and come under eighty banners, under each banner twelve thousand.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Ships and banners on the shore
shots.notes: QUOTE overlay on this shot: keep the top ~15–40% dark and calm.

shots.framing: Medium: dawn at a doorway; a young volunteer (18, no beard, a backpack) says goodbye to his mother; she presses a wrapped loaf into his hands and holds his face; behind him in the street other men walk past
shots.vo_markup: In every city, men answered the call. Farmers. Teachers. Boys too young to *shave.*
shots.vo: In every city, men answered the call. Farmers. Teachers. Boys too young to shave.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The mother's hands on his face

shots.framing: Medium: an empty classroom with chairs up, then (same shot, camera drifts) through its window a narrow street where a mother in a headscarf stands at an upstairs window, watching the road
shots.vo_markup: Schools emptied. Factories fell silent. On every street, a mother stood at a *window.*
shots.vo: Schools emptied. Factories fell silent. On every street, a mother stood at a window.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Empty chairs, the mother at the window

shots.framing: Wide: a mountain road at night; a long line of trucks' headlights winding north; inside the nearest cab a middle-aged farmer looks at a small printed photo of his family, then puts it in his pocket
shots.vo_markup: They drove north through the night, toward a valley none of them had ever *seen.*
shots.vo: They drove north through the night, toward a valley none of them had ever seen.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The photo, the line of lights

shots.framing: Extreme wide: dawn mist in a valley; two vast armies face each other from opposite slopes, banners above both; a single bird crosses the gap
shots.vo_markup: And at dawn, the two armies faced each other, at a place the Prophet had named fourteen centuries *before.*
shots.vo: And at dawn, the two armies faced each other, at a place the Prophet had named fourteen centuries before.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Two armies, the empty valley between
shots.notes: CLIFFHANGER: heartbeat. The bird crosses on "before".

shots.framing: TITLE CARD: "EIGHTY BANNERS" + "CHAPTER 9 · THE LAST DAYS" over dark mist with faint banners
shots.speaker: narr
shots.notes: Deep bass drop on the cut.
